summary: FM electric piano (DX7-style): glassy, 80s ballads and synth-pop
label: FM electric piano
body: Register: MIDI 40-88 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/FM Electric Piano, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/FM Electric Piano") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
